method.method_draft: Read the diagram as an isosceles trapezoid XYZW with parallel bases WZ and XY. From the image, the upper base WZ is labeled 8 and the lower base XY is labeled 20; the 70° angle at Y is not needed. From the text, the requested quantity is the length of the trapezoid median. Apply the trapezoid median formula: the median length equals the average of the two bases, so median = (8 + 20) / 2 = 14.
